clues.description: A small metal tag with serial and model information.
detail_points: Tag ID: AS-7894
Attached to Model X30 server unit.
Shows routine maintenance on 25 October at 10:00 AM.
Serial number matches the company database for asset tracking.
clues.supports: Demonstrates legitimate use of equipment in recent operations.

clues.name: Voicemail Recording
clues.description: A digital audio message from a company phone line.
detail_points: Left by Security Chief, Mr Davies.
Expresses regret about an access denial recorded at 14:30 this afternoon.
Reference to 'unverified personnel' during the call.
Includes direct admission to being off-duty when accessed.
clues.supports: Harms your case by implying improper timing for the access issue.

clues.name: Team Photo Collage
clues.description: A standard corporate print with framed images.
detail_points: Features DataSecure employees including Director Evans.
Taken on 8 August at Central HQ facility.
All individuals appear to have current ID badges present.
Display is in the main waiting area for orientation reference.
clues.supports: Adds visual context without directly implicating or exonerating.

clues.name: Database Access Terminal
clues.description: An electronic device displaying access records.
detail_points: Access granted at 09:15 by ID #42387 for server room entry.
No override or denial recorded during the incident window.
Shows entries from senior staff like Mr Davies only.
Timestamps indicate authorized activity within standard hours.
clues.supports: Provides evidence of controlled access excluding your claim.

clues.name: Digital Wall Timepiece
clues.description: A clock displaying the current time.
detail_points: Shows 16:45 hours.
Last updated for official duty log entry on shift start date only.
Standard office clock face indicating ongoing operations during core hours.
Date marker is set to yesterday's deadline.
clues.supports: Contextualizes the time without adding direct information.

clues.name: Company Identification Card
clues.description: A plastic card with employee details.
detail_points: Employee name: Alistair Finch.
ID number #42387 printed on front side.
Department listed as 'Data Management' under security protocols.
Current badge status approved until the end of this calendar month.
clues.supports: Helps confirm your identity and department assignment.
